notes.title: XMAS UPDATE 1.20
notes.content:
Long promised update is available! Enjoy!

[b]NEW HORDE MAP : MINIONS MASSACRE[/b]

A new Huge Indoor level for endless killing of mass groups of Zombies. Boost items excluded for added difficulty.

[b]NEW HORDE MAP : HELL AWAITS[/b]

Small defence map. 2 Gate Turrets are here to help you. New Item " Turret Upgrade" ( UP Arrow) for upgrading Turret damage deal. Beware turrets run out of ammunition, be sure to reload them ;-)

[b]NEW ENEMIES : ZOMBIES[/b]

All new 9 variations of zombies/animations waiting to be slaughtered in Minions Massacre!
[b]
NEW TRAINING/TUTORIAL MAP[/b]

Get started with the basics of Rest In Pieces (English only at the momment)

[b]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/b]

- Enemies that land a successful attack, will chase you faster
- GRIP can be switched to HOLD/TOGGLE (mostly for VIVE or WMR users)
- Main UI is optimized and scaled to be readable
- Back and Strafe movement speed raised
- SEATED play now works as intedeed
- VR Hands better aligned to controllers
- Grabing weapons from upperhead slots now is fixed
- Added Smooth Turning
- Option to remove black fade when snaping

[b]HEAVY OPTIMIZATIONS[/b]

Finally made optimizations on all aspects of RIP. You may see raised FPS from 30%-60%! Textures also were reduced so you might get less vram required to render more crisp textures in game.

[b]OTHER FIXES AND CHANGES[/b]

- Improved Player Height setting
- Fixed Re-sloted weapons would have flashlight/laser on
- Removed Rain FX
- Added Teleporting SFX
- Fixed a Bug where VR hand would run in slow speeds
- WMR reload buttons remapped
- When you make option changes the APPLY button will flash to save
- Added HTC COSMOS controller mapping
- Dead Awaken map was re-polished
- Main menu Music has boosted Bass and Slower Tempo
- AI freezing was improved
- Achievement Text were corrected
- Added StormingTech logo on initialization

That's all! I really hope you enjoy! Rest In Pieces lads ;-)

ohhh. and Merry Christmas to everyone!

[b]PS. a MAC version is planned to be pushed today. Stay tuned![/b]

notes.title: ALL HEADSETS SUPPORT 1.05
notes.content:
Hello everyone! as promised today ALL HEADSETS update 1.05 is live!!!

Please Note : some inputs might not work exactly as expected, please report for any issues on the forums of Rest In Pieces, i will perform daily updates until every issue is fixed ;-)

New Update Support only Steam VR ( Oculus SDK was removed )

SUPPORTED HEADSETS :

- RIFT / S
- VALVE'S INDEX 
- VIVE / PRO / COSMOS
- ALL WMR 

NEW STEAM VR INPUT KEY BINDING is supported, so you can re-map actions, althought i believe most motion controller should be ok with the defaults.

ALSO FIXED :

- When using Scoped Weapon FPS would drop

Hopefully eveything runs as it should ;-)
